item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad band of clouds will cover Guangdong in the next couple of days. Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong early next week, and it will be rather warm during the day. Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, it will become cool appreciably over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
